Medium.title: The package claims a digest manifest that does not exist
Medium.evidence: Spec lines 238-241 describe the evidence directory as containing a manifest, line 465 asks the reviewer to recompute its digest, and line 506 declares success. A recursive inventory found 35 pre-review files and no SHA256SUMS. `finalize_evidence.py verify` exited 1 with `ERROR: cannot read manifest ... SHA256SUMS`.
Medium.violated_requirement: Pre-court package completeness, reproducibility, and the evidence-quote-linter sealing workflow require a self-excluding SHA-256 manifest when the package claims one.
Medium.impact: The untracked evidence package is mutable and cannot be verified as the exact frozen package reviewed. The direct manifest claim is false, so status=success is not Court-ready.
Medium.required_correction: After all final receipts, including this review, are frozen, use an explicitly authorized sealing session to run `finalize_evidence.py seal <evidence-dir>`, preserve the command/streams/RC/UTC receipt, then run `finalize_evidence.py verify <evidence-dir>`. Update the spec only through the authorized append-only/new-spec workflow so it names the manifest digest rather than merely claiming one.
Medium.verification_required: Fresh manifest verification RC 0, evidence quote lint RC 0, and a new independent pre-court pass over the sealed bytes.

Medium.title: Two mandatory companion-process records are author summaries rather than complete receipts
Medium.evidence: Spec lines 486-504 mark verification_before_completion and independent_review COMPLETED, but omit required completed_at_utc and bounded_output fields; their invocation text is a prose description rather than the exact command/invocation. Referenced artifacts are useful evidence, but the companion records do not bind the claimed process completion to a complete receipt.
Medium.violated_requirement: The governing pre-court skill requires applicability, status, exact command or invocation, bounded output, UTC timestamp, and artifact location for every applicable companion process; an author statement is not a receipt.
Medium.impact: A different reviewer cannot establish when or exactly how the mandatory completion gates ran, so Court clearance lacks required process provenance.
Medium.required_correction: Create digest-bound companion receipts for verification-before-completion and independent review. Each must record exact invocation, full bounded stdout/stderr, exit code, UTC start/completion, reviewer relationship, and artifact path. Then reference those receipts from a new append-only spec revision.
Medium.verification_required: Schema inspection confirms every mandatory field; receipt artifact digests are covered by the final SHA256SUMS; independent re-review confirms timestamps do not precede the work they attest.

Medium.title: The asserted independent visual-review verdict is not evidenced by its cited capture
Medium.evidence: Spec lines 306-310 claim an independent visual review found no Critical, Important, or Minor issue, but screenshot-inventory.json contains only 18 filename/size/SHA-256 rows. It has no reviewer relationship, screenshots inspected, visual findings, or verdict.
Medium.violated_requirement: Every material manual claim must identify the reviewer, scope, observations, timestamp, and artifact; author narrative cannot be substituted for an independent review receipt.
Medium.impact: The core investor-stage visual-quality clearance is not reproducible from the submitted package even though screenshot integrity itself is valid.
